headline: Mooring County Erupts as Weathered Expanse Fighting Quickens
war_summary: The front has shifted since the previous edition. Mooring County, quiet in earlier reports, is now the war's hottest ledger: Colonial casualties have leapt to some 208 an hour against a Warden 105, and The Wind Hills has passed to Colonial hands, leaving eleven Warden works to one. In Weathered Expanse the Colonial colours have reappeared, now six Warden works, one Colonial and two unclaimed, with three actions in the last two hours, twenty-four in six and fifty-two across the day about Crow's Nest, Wightwalk and Spirit Watch, where casualties on both sides are climbing. The Nevish Line stands unchanged at seven Warden works to one Colonial, though no fresh action was logged in the last two hours after some sixty-eight events in the day around Blackcoat Way, Princefal and Grief Mother. Marban Hollow holds at six Colonial, one Warden and one unclaimed; Linn Mercy at ten Colonial and one unclaimed. Kuura Strand has gone silent since yesterday evening. Heavy losses without a change of colours continue in the Dead Lands, Callahan's Passage, Stlican Shelf and Stonecradle, the last of these quickening.
